title: 고등법원 부장판사급 이상의 법관의 보직범위에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02512:20131231:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부장판사급 이상의 법관의 보직범위에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on the Operation of the Judicial Policy Research Institute) <Supreme Court Rule No. 2512, December 31, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2014.

Article 2 (Amendment to Other Rules)
(1) through (11) Omitted.

(12) The Rules on the Scope of Positions of Judges of the Rank of Presiding Judge of a High Court or Higher shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraphs 3 and 10 of Article 2 shall be replaced respectively with the following:
3. President of the Judicial Research and Training Institute or President of the Judicial Policy Research Institute;
10. Chief Professor of the Judicial Research and Training Institute or Chief Research Fellow of the Judicial Policy Research Institute.

(13) Omitted.
